notes: Part 3 of 3 of the IMD6900 Frens on-chain art: deploy FrenArtChunk5, FrenArtChunk6 and FrenArtChunk7 from src/FrenArtChunks.sol without constructor arguments, then FrenRenderer from src/FrenRenderer.sol. Use the accepted art and FrenArtIndex unchanged, including FrenArtChunk7's PUSH32 framing.
